subject: Air pollution etches its signature on Alzheimer's-vulnerable brain regions
script: From Agewell Brief: Air pollution etches its signature on Alzheimer's-vulnerable brain regions. New USC-led neuroimaging research links common outdoor air pollutants to structural changes in the very brain areas most susceptible to Alzheimer's pathology. Here's what the physical evidence shows—and what it doesn't. Your brain is not a sealed vault. Read the full source-linked dispatch and primary study caveats at AgewellBrief.com.
